prerequisites: Human consent and reviewer acceptance of the full transaction, including this separate diagnostic write span.
Transaction owner captured fresh calculator/SD/RTC/IP trajectory and double fresh full Flash before any write.
Raw cold/reset/crash/watchdog/BOOTSEL observations captured before this stage and before health/reset/retry/clear.
Install exact V138 plus the explicitly separate reference sectors, preserving all outside affected erase sectors.
Fresh full post-install 2MiB readback at {output}/candidate-readback.bin; base prefix and addon independently verified.
USB ownership held by the transaction owner; same UID awake125MHz, command mode, idle, valid firmware CRC.

duration.basis: Historical87 completed timing chunks took530 seconds wall time,111.9 seconds inside APP warmup/measurement;120 launches scale to about731 seconds before current USB/SD/IRQ variability. Allow12–20 minutes; this is an estimate, not V138 physical evidence.

cancellation.raw: Each stage: NNN.bin and NNN.guard.bin; decoded12 raw/calibration/cache rounds in NNN.json
cancellation.resume: Explicit --resume requires same package SHA/UID and verified saved raw files; a new live SD directory is required. Parent must supply a new verified post-install full readback.
cancellation.failure: Save raw transcript/status/crash/identity before recovery. No retry/reset/keys/BOOTSEL/flash from the math runner. Parent owns exact fresh restore in finally.
cancellation.cleanup: Own SD directory only, on successful or cooperative-stop path; do not delete/recover on device failure.

physical_cycle_scope: TIMERAWL microseconds times125 at checked125MHz; physical cycle equivalents with125-cycle batch quantization, not an independent core cycle counter.
interrupts: enabled; paired calibration and both-core XIP counters retained
acceptance_scope: Finite public API correctness and paired physical timing. A successful execution status does not assert faster/equal cycles, all-input correctness or general-pow totality.
